facts.fact: Missing authentication, missing job and job owner mismatch intentionally return404; a missing/out-of-scope preview also returns404. GET404 cannot prove parse failure or identify an auth failure by itself.
order_confirmed is true only for state completed with result.order_confirmed===true. A preview may already be durable ready before the job is complete.
Failed job response retains authorized book preview. Failure text is generic, not a parse-error reason code.
Ready/canonical content survives later recency confirmation, chapter-count or cleanup failure; terminal failed plus ready preview is a real possible DTO.
Non-ready own record can be marked error after each failed attempt while BullMQ will retry. Active/delayed/waiting status must not be overridden to terminal parse failure solely by preview.error.
Three attempts with exponential5000ms backoff; completed results retained24h, failed results72h. A later unavailable job remains an uncertain lookup result.
Pending row, queued job or complete synchronous result can be committed before the client loses the POST response. Automatic POST retransmission is not a safe status check.
Server queue registration uses stable bookId jobId plus one lookup after an ambiguous add response; this does not guarantee a browser has received either ID.

Canonical identity comes from returnvalue, persisted job canonicalBookId, or original bookId. Bounded re-read handles terminal/dedup snapshot races. Client should use authorized preview canonical ID, not infer prior membership.
Job preview RPC is read-only, scoped to uploader membership; database preview error503 is unconfirmed status, not failed content. Checking a job does not advance recency.

frontend_recommended_precedence: Honor account scope and classify transport/auth errors separately.
Valid authoritative ready preview stays ready even when job failed/order unconfirmed; expose a separate library-confirmation action.
Nonterminal job states continue same job; metadata may remain or have an error from a retryable attempt.
Terminal failed plus non-ready preview can show processing failure, without claiming a specific DRM/format cause.
Without usable job ID or with persistent404, offer library reconciliation; do not endlessly poll or automatically POST the file again.
remaining_limits: No API lookup of a lost submission by a client idempotency key; unknown receipt remains unknown until library reconciliation.
A manifest-only error without job receipt does not encode whether BullMQ has another scheduled attempt. Frontend can reconcile status but cannot claim a detailed server terminal reason.
No global upload request idempotency or new durable registration transaction introduced.
correctness_tests_not_repeated: Existing final389pass/11missing-fixture suite and native upload evidence correspond to current backend source; no source changes since ed7b30d. Four original EPUB parser checks are already covered; this review did not rerun imports or tests.
